project_type: TypeScript monorepo: React+Vite frontend (JA/EN i18n), Lambda backend, AWS CDK infra, shared pure-logic lib. Digimon-style monster-raising game (AIモンスター).
build_system: npm workspaces. Root `npm run build` = build shared -> backend -> frontend -> infra. Node may need: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH".
test_framework: node:test with --experimental-strip-types. Shared: packages/shared/src/__tests__/*.ts. Frontend pure helpers: packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts (imports from ui-helpers.ts).
test_command: npm test (shared, baseline 117 pass) AND npm test -w @ddm/frontend (frontend ui-helpers, baseline 99 pass)
verification_instructions: 1) export PATH for node v22. 2) npm run build must pass. 3) npm test (shared) stays green, count grows with new shared zukan tests. 4) npm test -w @ddm/frontend stays green, count grows with new frontend zukan-storage/helper tests. 5) Confirm no new runtime dependencies added to any package.json.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/frontend/dist is generated by `npm run build` (vite). Not committed-sensitive here. No snapshot test dirs.
setup_instructions: Repo already cloned at /projects/sandbox/kiro-digitalmonster on branch main, clean. Dependencies already installed (node_modules present; build+tests run green). export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" before node/npm.
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET. Do NOT push or open PRs (orchestrator handles that). Commit locally on branch feat/monster-zukan. Do NOT touch backup/previous-main branches. Frontend-only change: no backend, no Monster-type, no infra change expected; redeploy need is FRONTEND only.
contribution_requirements: i18n: packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts has JA_MESSAGES as source-of-truth and EN_MESSAGES typed Record<MessageKey,string>; every new key MUST have BOTH ja+en or the frontend tsc build fails. Keep JA byte-identical for existing keys. Pure logic (no DOM/React) belongs in shared or ui-helpers.ts so it is node:test-able. Respect prefers-reduced-motion in CSS. No new runtime deps.
key_patterns: Guarded localStorage helpers under `ddm.` prefix that NEVER throw (see ui-helpers.ts readPetRecordRaw/writePetRecord/readOnboarded and i18n readStoredLang). Accessible modal pattern: role=alertdialog + aria-modal, focus-on-open, Escape closes, two/N-button focus trap, focus restore to opener (App.tsx reset-confirm; components/NameDialog.tsx). Pure UI helpers tested in game-ui.test.ts. Monster.form via formOf()/normalizeForm() ('base'|'attack'|'defense'|'mischief'); stageId tier ('baby'|'rookie'|'champion'|'ultimate'). Monster.bornAt is epoch ms. Sprite: <MonsterSprite stageId form size />. Labels: stageLabel(stageId,lang) + formLabel(form,lang) in ui-helpers.ts.
relevant_files: packages/shared/src/index.ts (barrel export - add new zukan module here)
packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts (pure UI helpers + guarded storage pattern: readPetRecordRaw/writePetRecord)
packages/frontend/src/state/useMonster.ts (commit()/advance() lifecycle, reset() wipes monster but must NOT touch zukan)
packages/frontend/src/App.tsx (header controls, reset-confirm alertdialog pattern, sprite+MonsterSprite usage)
packages/frontend/src/components/NameDialog.tsx (accessible modal pattern to mirror for zukan modal)
directory_structure: packages/shared/src (pure logic + __tests__), packages/backend/src (Lambda handlers - NOT touched), packages/frontend/src (React UI: App.tsx, components/, assets/monsters/, state/, ui-helpers.ts, i18n.ts, styles.css, game-ui.test.ts), infra (CDK - NOT touched).
